About Neo4j:

Neo4j is the graph intelligence platform that transforms data into knowledge to power the next generation of intelligent applications and AI systems. It includes enterprise-ready knowledge graphs for accurate, explainable, and governed AI; the most comprehensive, trusted, and easy-to-deploy graph capabilities across any environment and data source; and an unmatched ecosystem trusted by 84 of the Fortune 100 and supported by the world’s largest graph community. Intelligence that works. Results that matter.

Built to work everywhere and integrate with everything across every cloud for dynamic, personalized, and autonomous AI systems. We deliver quicker results, contextual knowledge, and solutions that impact customers and employees across the business.

Our Vision: 

At Neo4j, we have always strived to help the world make sense of data.  

As business, society and knowledge become increasingly connected, our technology promotes innovation by helping organizations to find and understand data relationships. We created, drive and lead the graph database category, and we’re disrupting how organizations leverage their data to innovate and stay competitive.

About the Role

Neo4j is seeking a Senior Manager, Global Tax and Treasury to manage the tax and treasury function for a global, high-growth enterprise software company. This is a high-visibility, hands-on role with end-to-end responsibility for global tax compliance and planning, cash and liquidity management, banking and the processes and controls needed to support Neo4j's continued international growth.

The role will partner closely with Accounting, FP&A, Legal, and external advisors across Neo4j's global operations. The successful candidate will combine strong technical judgment with an operator's mindset: comfortable setting strategy, working through complex cross-border matters, and executing the underlying work in a lean environment.

What You'll Do

Tax

  • Own Neo4j's global tax compliance calendar, including U.S. federal, state, and local income and franchise taxes; international corporate income taxes; sales and use taxes; and VAT/GST across the jurisdictions in which Neo4j operates
  • Manage global tax advisors and coordinate the preparation and review of income tax returns, estimated payments, extensions, tax audits, and other tax authority inquiries
  • Lead the income tax provision process under ASC 740, including deferred taxes, valuation allowances, uncertain tax positions, tax account reconciliations, and support for the annual financial statement audit
  • Own transfer pricing policies, intercompany agreements, and contemporaneous documentation for cross-border services, software and intellectual property arrangements, and intercompany funding
  • Manage indirect tax compliance and strategy for Neo4j's software subscriptions, cloud offerings, professional services, marketplace transactions, and channel sales, including nexus analyses, registrations, exemption documentation, and product taxability
  • Evaluate the tax implications of new products and commercial models, international expansion, legal entity changes, acquisitions, and post-acquisition integration
  • Monitor international tax developments relevant to Neo4j, including OECD requirements as applicable, withholding and permanent establishment exposure, and evolving SaaS taxability rules
  • Establish scalable, audit-ready tax processes, documentation, and internal controls, and identify opportunities to improve data quality and reduce reliance on manual processes
  • Oversee the global tax compliance requirements associated with employee equity compensation, including stock options and RSUs, and coordinate local tax withholding, payroll, reporting, and employer compliance requirements 
  • Oversee tax attributes and incentives, including R&D tax credits and net operating losses, and coordinate ownership-change analyses under Section 382 with external advisors

Treasury

  • Own global cash management, including daily cash visibility and cash concentration across legal entities, bank accounts, and currencies
  • Manage banking relationships and the bank account lifecycle, including account openings and closures, signatories, administrative access, and appropriate segregation of duties
  • Administer Neo4j's debt facilities, including covenant monitoring, interest and fee calculations, lender reporting, and coordination of required deliverables with Accounting, FP&A, and Legal
  • Manage foreign exchange exposures and recommend practical risk-mitigation appropriate for Neo4j's international revenue, operating costs, and intercompany balances
  • Oversee the investment of excess cash in accordance with company policy, balancing preservation of capital, liquidity and yield
  • Structure and administer intercompany funding, loans, settlements, and repatriation in partnership with Tax, Accounting, and Legal
  • Own treasury policies and controls, including dual approvals, payment and wire controls, bank portal access reviews, fraud prevention, and support for acquisition integration and financing activities

Cross-Functional

  • Partner with Accounting on the monthly close and financial reporting for cash, debt, interest, FX, intercompany balances, and income taxes, ensuring timely reconciliations and clear ownership of deliverables
  • Partner with FP&A on liquidity forecasting and with Legal on entity governance, intercompany arrangements, financings, and regulatory requirements
  • Drive systems and process improvements across NetSuite, tax applications, and banking platforms, and prepare concise reporting for finance leadership as needed

What We're Looking For

  • 7+ years of progressive tax experience, with meaningful exposure to treasury operations; Big 4 or national firm experience is required
  • Strong knowledge of U.S. corporate and multi-state taxation, ASC 740, and core international tax concepts, including transfer pricing.
  • Experience with indirect tax issues affecting enterprise software, SaaS, cloud services, professional services and cloud marketplace transactions.
  • Treasury experience covering global banking, debt administration, intercompany funding, and foreign exchange exposure management
  • CPA or advanced degree in taxation preferred; CTP or relevant  treasury experience is a plus
  • Experience working across multiple international legal entities within a global, high-growth software company; acquisition integration experience is a plus
  • Comfortable operating with significant ownership in a lean team, moving fluidly between strategy, technical analysis, process design, and hands-on execution
  • Advanced Excel and financial modeling skills; experience with NetSuite, tax compliance and provision tools, and global banking platforms is preferred
  • Excellent communication and project-management skills, with the ability to translate complex tax and treasury matters for finance leadership and cross-functional stakeholders
  • Demonstrated ability to establish scalable, well-controlled processes and maintain audit-ready documentation in a rapidly evolving environment

The annual base salary range for this position based in the United States is listed below. This salary range is an estimate, and the actual salary may vary based on Neo4j’s compensation practices, job related skills, depth of experience, relevant certifications and trainings, in addition to geographic location. Based on the factors above, Neo4j utilizes the full width of the range.

In addition to the range below, US employees are eligible for a stock option grant and certain roles are eligible for an annual bonus. Employees in this position are also eligible to participate in the Company’s standard benefit programs, which currently include the following: medical, dental, and vision benefits, 401(k), paid time off, and certain leaves of absence.

Annual Base Salary Range for This Role
$160,000—$200,000 USD
Why Join Neo4j?

Neo4j is, without question, the most popular graph intelligence platform in the world. We have customers in every industry globally, and our products are a proven product/market fit. Joining our team is an opportunity to shape the future of data and analytics. Below are just a few exciting facts about Neo4j. 

  • Neo4j is one of the fastest-scaling technology companies in this industry. It recently surpassed $200M in annual recurring revenue (ARR), doubling its ARR over the past three years. 
  • Raised the biggest funding round in database history ($325M Series F). Backed by world-class investors like Eurazeo, GV (formerly Google Ventures), and Inovia Capital, Neo4j has raised over $600M in funding and is currently valued at over $2Bn. This puts Neo4j among the most well-funded database companies in history.
  • 84% of the Fortune 100 and 58% of the Fortune 500 use Neo4j. Examples include Boston Scientific, BT Group, Caterpillar, Cisco, Comcast, Department for Education UK, eBay, NBC News, Novo Nordisk, Worldline, and others. 
  • Co-founder and CEO Emil Eifrem has built an amazing culture that prides itself on relationships, inclusiveness, innovation, and customer success.
  • Countless industry awards. Massive enterprises and individual developers/data scientists love Neo4j. A strong sense of community and ecosystem is built around the platform.
  • A recent Forrester Total Economic Impact™ Study cited Neo4j as delivering 417% ROI to customers. 

Research shows that members of underrepresented communities are less likely to apply for jobs when they don’t meet all the qualifications. If this is part of the reason you hesitate to apply, we’d encourage you to reconsider and give us the opportunity to review your application. At Neo4j, we are committed to building awareness and helping to improve these issues. 

One of our central objectives is to provide an inclusive, diverse, and equitable workplace for everyone to develop their potential and have a positive, career-defining experience. We look forward to receiving your application.
